preconditions.description: The number of cards n and required power k are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= 1000 and 1 <= c <= 100000 and 1 <= l <= n for p, c, l in cards)
preconditions.description: Each card's power, magic number, and level are within specified bounds.
The input contains exactly n card definitions.

postconditions.expression: is_prime_sum_free(deck) and sum(card['p'] for card in deck) >= k and all(card['l'] <= min_level for card in deck)
postconditions.description: The output min_level allows selecting a subset of cards (deck) where no two cards have a prime sum of magic numbers, total power is at least k, and all selected cards have level <= min_level.

postconditions.expression: not any(is_prime_sum_free(deck) and sum(card['p'] for card in deck) >= k and all(card['l'] <= L for card in deck) for L in range(1, min_level) for deck in all_subsets(cards))
postconditions.description: The output min_level is the minimum integer such that a valid deck exists; no smaller level L allows a valid deck.

postconditions.expression: output == '-1' if not any(is_prime_sum_free(deck) and sum(card['p'] for card in deck) >= k for deck in all_subsets(cards)) else str(min_level)
postconditions.description: If no valid deck exists for any level, output -1; otherwise output the minimum level as a string.
